name: name_crono
doc: Stands in for saves/crononame.state: from atb_vram A takes Active ($2990 84 -> C4) and opens the new game's Crono naming screen, the 'Enter a name, then push the Start Button.' box over the keyboard, nothing typed yet; 120 frames settle it (the box crop is the same from 40 to 300). WRAM differs from the reference in 26 bytes (frame counters).
